name: The Worst Sonic the Hedgehog Romhack (Featuring Mario) 2
summary:
After the events of the first game mario got bored of dying so he decides to check out how the worlds like after 80 years of being dead.

This hack while being the worst, has fair enough level design (and more effort then the previous one) And its completely playable.
There are no zones in this hack! Instead all the levels are all different from eachother
There are no rings, but instead you can get a mushroom which grants 1 extra hit
you will only have 1 live but this time around you can actually gain more lives! Almost every stage has a life to collect.
The spike "feature" is still here! Well except for in 1 stage....
This along with useless gimmicks, somewhat new bosses, will make you question how romhacking has not died yet, so be ready for the romhack of all time.
